reviews.title: UPDATE please 🙏🏻!
reviews.text:
Be aware: This app is being neglected by the developer. The Mac version still crashes regularly on macOS 26, and on iOS the app doesn’t support the new Liquid Glass look — which makes parts of the interface unreadable. I’ve already sent two emails, but never received a reply. 😢

Original review:

This is a great app. For €2,29 you get an app for your Mac, your iPhone (with very useful widgets!) and your AppleWatch (with a nice complication). The WatchApp makes it (in times of Corona and mouthmasks preventing you from quickly opening your phone with FaceID) extremely useful. With one glance at your Watch, you know everything you need to know. Tip: it would be nice to see a break (eg. a 10 minute break) between hours in portrait mode.

Request: please add a real complication (instead of an app-icon for the modular watchfaces! 🙏🏻).
